_comment: t8-A4 obfs4 self-vectors. The values below are GOLDEN OUTPUTS of crates/spt-obfs/src/obfs4.rs, NOT obfs4proxy-derived. They lock the current implementation's KDF + framing layer against silent regression. See `.orchestration/logs/t8-A4.md` and `.orchestration/logs/t8-FixObfs4.md` for the wire-compat caveat. To regenerate, see crates/spt-obfs/tests/README.md.
_framing_primitive: XSalsa20-Poly1305 (NaCl crypto_secretbox), 24-byte counter nonce, length prefix XOR-masked. Updated in t8-FixObfs4 from the earlier ChaCha20-Poly1305 stand-in.

frame_vectors._comment: t8-FixObfs4: regenerated against XSalsa20-Poly1305 (NaCl secretbox) framing with XOR-obfuscated 2-byte length prefix. The previous value was the output of the legacy ChaCha20-Poly1305 stand-in and is no longer valid.
frame_vectors.name: frame_zero_nonce_short_payload

obfs4proxy_interop_vectors._comment: Reserved for future obfs4proxy-derived vectors. Currently empty because the NTOR construction in spt-obfs/src/obfs4.rs still folds B into the HKDF salt rather than concatenating two ECDH outputs per spec (see t8-A4 bug A4-1). t8-FixObfs4 corrected the framing primitive (ChaCha20-Poly1305 → XSalsa20-Poly1305) but the NTOR realignment is out of scope. Populate from `obfs4proxy -enableLogging -unsafeLogging` once both layers match spec.
